description: This Swift file defines a class 'DevicePairingApprovalPrompter' responsible for managing device pairing requests, including presenting alerts to users, handling responses, and coordinating communication with a gateway for device pairing approval or rejection in a macOS application.

classes.name: DevicePairingApprovalPrompter
classes.description: A singleton class managing device pairing approval prompts, including network interactions, alert presentation, and response handling.

classes.name: PairingList
classes.description: A Codable struct representing lists of pending and paired devices obtained from the gateway.

classes.name: PairedDevice
classes.description: A Codable, Equatable struct representing a paired device with its attributes.

classes.name: PendingRequest
classes.description: A Codable, Equatable, Identifiable struct representing a pending device pairing request with relevant request details.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates the pairing prompt process by starting the push task.

methods.name: startPushTask
methods.description: Begins listening for pairing push events and load pending requests.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops listening for pairing events and clears pending requests.

methods.name: stopPushTask
methods.description: Stops the pairing push task and cleans up states.

methods.name: loadPendingRequestsFromGateway
methods.description: Asynchronously loads pending pairing requests from the gateway.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies a list of pairing requests, sorts them, and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: updatePendingCounts
methods.description: Updates the count of pending requests and repair requests.

methods.name: presentNextIfNeeded
methods.description: Displays the next pairing request alert if one is not already being presented.

methods.name: presentAlert
methods.description: Displays an alert for a specific pairing request.

methods.name: handleAlertResponse
methods.description: Handles user's response to the pairing alert and takes appropriate action.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Approves a pairing request via the gateway and logs the event.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Rejects a pairing request via the gateway.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles incoming push events related to device pairing requests and resolutions.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.description: Adds a new pairing request to the queue and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: handleResolved
methods.description: Handles resolution events for pairing requests, updating the queue and logs.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Provides a textual description of a pairing request for display in alerts.
